config.name: phase7-confirmatory-sift1m-direct-vs-certified-v1
config.primary_hypothesis: At SIFT1M N=1000000, K=10, the frozen geometric certified NPU method is faster than native direct NPU TopK.
config.test: two-sided exact sign-flip test over per-session mean log speedups
config.counterbalance: cyclic method and query order by session
config.required_correctness: zero skips and exact agreement over stored FP16 scores in every session
